# 1.2.120 - the owner's urgent fixes: the planner's sort, Move, lines and toolbar, Foundry's token HUD trimmed and none for a player, the GM's fog redrawn when the browser cannot store it, and the Mastermind's Give Hope box

One stage ships: E120 (tools/stages.json), the owner's table reports and asks of 21.11.2026 on 1.2.119, built by four
lines and merged into one assembly: P (the planner), H (the token HUD), F (the fog) and the Give Hope box (found by the
line that reworks the windows' refresh for 1.2.121). **E39, E40, E43, E53, E58 and E83 are not shipped** and move to
1.2.123 (tools/stages.json, 14d31228). E26 stays 1.3.0. The audit of 1.2.118's open major findings, re-read on 1.2.119,
is not in this release: its lines are built and wait for 1.2.121. From e515907d (main at 1.2.119, tag v1.2.119) to
14d31228: 21 commits, 8 of them merges of the lines into the assembly (`git rev-list --count` and `--merges --count`
over e515907d..14d31228); this release commit comes on top.

In plain words. Everything below is read off the code, the headless harness and shots of static pages in Chromium; none
of it has run on a real Foundry or at a table (## Checked).

**The planner** (line P; the owner, 21.11.2026: "Linie w planerze - niech omijaja nodes ... Sortowanie dalej wydaje sie
nie dzialac w planerze. Po najechaniu myszka caly node robi sie bialy").
- A sort picked on the Map redraws every column in the new order at once, with no Save. The cause: a select picked
  with the pointer held the window's redraw until the pointer was released, and a browser's own list may never hand the
  page that release; now a `change` inside the window ends the hold, and a forced redraw waiting behind it is kept
  forced (live.mjs `heldForced`; R8012). The Table's filters had the same delay and redraw at once too.
- Each sort draws its order in every column, not only the first; "fewer crossings" still places by its own rule
  (case-view.mjs `mapPlace`; R8013).
- Move up and Move down move a node one place in every column, and the GM's order is kept there (the owner's option A;
  R8010, R8011, N119-6).
- A node's fields on the Map (its name, its trial mode, its "Rests on" ticks) are written on each change, and the Map
  draws them at once; the Logic Dive set picker lists a set saved while the Map is open.
- Hovering a node no longer turns it white: the theme's glass brush painted bone on bone (1:1); the node now reads at
  9.65:1 (components.css, tools/contrast-pairs.json `case-node-hover-*`).
- **Lines no longer pass over nodes.** A line to a column further on runs through a gap, and the nodes in between move
  down to make room (case-view.mjs `routePlan`, `mapPlace`; R8014). A crowded case grows taller. Not covered: a line back
  to an earlier column that skips a column (none in the cases read).
- The column-order picker is drawn at the same size as the toolbar's other controls, and the toolbar fits on one row in a
  window about 1000 px wide or wider (components.css).

**Foundry's token HUD** (line H; the owner, 21.11.2026: "Niepotrzebne jest: combat, target, movement action, assign
status, liczby na gorze i na dole i elevation ... ogolnie nie pasuje to do reszty modulu"; approved on its shots).
- A GM's token HUD keeps only show/hide, bring to front or send back, lock/unlock, the token's settings, the floor palette
  on a scene with several floors, and Daggerheart's companion and party buttons. Elevation, the two bar numbers, the
  status palette, the movement action, target and combat are gone (token-hud.mjs `trimTokenHud`; R8050-R8053).
- **A player has no token HUD** (the owner: "Niech gracz nie ma menu tokena"): a right click on their own token opens
  nothing.
- Every kept control wears a module glyph in both themes, with a tooltip in the table's language that turns with its
  state (three new glyphs: legacy:lock-open, legacy:stairs, glass:lock-open).
- Where the removed controls went is in the four handbooks (the GM's and the player's, English and Polish). The bars
  are still drawn on the token; that targeting with the T key still works is a check for the table (LIVE-H120-01).

**The GM's fog** (line F; the owner's report on 1.2.119: "Mgla u GMa nie odswieza sie wcale", cured by Reset the season).
- When the browser's storage is full, a GM store's write fails, and before this release whatever draws that store (the
  GM's fog among them) never heard of the change, through any number of F5. Now the store tells it anyway, for a GM's
  store and for a player's copy (gm-store.mjs; R8031). That this was the cause at the owner's table is not read (the
  "could not save" notice appears once).
- A fog dissolve whose end throws no longer stops the fog redrawing, and one whose end never comes is let go after
  1750 ms; `game.drpg.diagnoseFog()` reports a dissolve's hold (fog.mjs; R8030). The GM handbook's section 20.3 says
  which call to run when the GM's own map stops changing.
- The Fog tab's Mastermind column, disabled since E91, now says why: "The Mastermind knows every room. Your map does
  not show where they go." (DRPG.Vault.fogMastermind).

**The Mastermind window** (found and fixed by the windows' refresh line; present on 1.2.119).
- The Give Hope box no longer loses its pool, amount and Give button the first time the window updates
  (mastermind.mjs; one tier-2 test).

## Before installing

- **No migration step** (scripts/migrate.mjs has no change). No setting is added or removed (`game.settings.register` on
  202 lines of scripts/ at both ends); settings.mjs changes in comments only. The GMs' stores keep their definitions
  (gm-stores.mjs has no change).
- **Language**: lang/en.json goes from 6402 to 6409 keys: 7 added (`DRPG.TokenHud.config`, `.hide`, `.level`, `.lock`,
  `.show`, `.sort`, `.unlock`), none removed, 1 changed in wording (`DRPG.Vault.fogMastermind`). lang/pl.json goes from
  7499 to 7506, the same 7 added and 1 changed. Counted on the flattened files, e515907d against 14d31228.
- Three glyphs added to icons/pixel-sprite.svg and tools/glyphs.json (above). No console name changed
  (tools/api-surface.json has no change in the range).
- **Daggerheart**: `verified` stays 2.12.9; the token HUD was read on Daggerheart 2.12.8's template. **Foundry**:
  module.json's compatibility has no change (minimum 14.364, verified 14.365); the owner's sandbox runs 14.370, which
  module.json does not name.

## Known gaps

- **Not shipped**: E39, E40, E43, E53, E58 and E83 (tools/stages.json, planned 1.2.123). E26 stays 1.3.0.
- **The audit of 1.2.118's major findings is not in this release**: the masked killer's name on cards served later and
  on Monocub panels, the opening's veil on boards and the camera, the murder rules and clean-up, the windows that do not
  yet refresh at once, Room setup and Season setup, and release.yml reusing a green CI run are built on their own
  branches and planned for 1.2.121; the rest of the audit for 1.2.122.
- **A select held open in another window still waits**: in the Sound window's Music tab, another GM's change is not drawn
  while a row's select keeps the focus (measured headless on this tree). The fix is in the windows' refresh line, 1.2.121.
- **No local gate has passed**: E120 declares sockets, rolls and scenes, so the gate is required, and no part of it has
  run on this release's tree; the record in the tree, audit/gate/local-gate.json, says every part not run for want of a
  server. Nothing in this release has run on a real Foundry or at a table.
- **Tier 2 at a table is not green**: line L1's last whole run of tier 2 on the owner's 14.370 sandbox, at d5907e1b,
  read 1326 passed, 214 failed, 26 skipped of 1566 (docs/dev/e58/LOCAL-REPORT.md); no whole run since, on any Foundry.
- **Two veil predicates**: mask-gm.mjs `veiledFromHere` and visibility.mjs `voiceVeiledHere`, as at 1.2.119.
- **Carried, not closed**: the 11 rows of audit/harness/known-leaks.json, as at 1.2.119; a race in the harness's fuzz
  (lib/fuzz.mjs, no change in the range). The rest of 1.2.119's list stands as its notes give it.
